description: CASCADE (Counter-based Asymmetric Stem-Cell Aging: Division Counters & Entropy Export) — a quantitative model of organismal aging: asymmetric division exports entropy/damage, division counters (centriole, telomeres, mtDNA, proteostasis, epigenetic mitotic clock) accumulate, and self-renewal declines with the organismal damage load. Formally verified mathematical core in Lean 4 + Mathlib (0 errors) and a stochastic multi-counter simulation in Rust.
title: CASCADE: Counter-based Asymmetric Stem-Cell Aging — Division Counters & Entropy Export (organismal-aging model; Lean 4 + Rust)
